title: Admin panel — marketing, content & Open Souq — browser test report
area: Admin panel: coupons, flash sales, gift cards & vouchers, Nawy One, marketers & campaigns, ads, travel promotions, pages & CMS, classifieds
summary: Coupons (category-scoped percentage, BOGO with validation, edit, toggle, filter) and coupon participation; a flash-sale event created (Oman-time hints, end-before-start refused), moved and cancelled; gift cards issued and voided, vouchers created and voided; Nawy One plans added and the existing plan saved unchanged; marketers suspended/reactivated, a platform campaign created and paused, settings saved, celebrity report regenerated; ads review queues, travel-promotion options and slot, advertise requests, exclusive-contract validation; pages created in the page builder, scheduled; app contexts, live broadcasts, blog, help centre, static pages, footer and notification templates; Open Souq review (reject with reason, approve), abuse reports, category photo limits and contract requirement (changed and restored), travel review queue. One bug fixed (BT-ADM-004), the hidden-error bug BT-ADM-001 found here as well. Re-run of 2026-11-19 after the big development catalogue (5,000 products, about 30,000 offers and 60 sellers per country, new home and category pages, mega menu): the full Playwright suite ran on a fresh production build with E2eSeeder records; {COUNTS}.
environment: Admin panel http://admin.nawy.test:8000 (php artisan serve on :8000, Blade panels; Chromium maps *.nawy.test to 127.0.0.1)
Storefront http://localhost:3000 (next start) — not used by these flows
Dev databases (central noon-plus + nawy_uae …), MAIL_MAILER=log (2FA codes and invitation links read from storage/logs/laravel.log), NAWY_PAYMENTS_DRIVER=fake
Playwright 'areas' project, Desktop Chrome 1280×720, screenshots per step; servers shared with two other QA agents

Each worker signs the e2e admin in once with its own session (password + emailed code), cached in the OS temp dir; the shared e2e/.auth/admin.json is never used or rewritten (a shared session loses flash messages and validation errors to parallel requests)

Run: cd website && E2E_SKIP_SEED=1 npx playwright test --project=areas --no-deps e2e/specs/areas/admin --workers=2 (iteration used e2e/specs/areas/admin/.qa.config.ts, the same config without the global setup that signs the shared customer in and was rate-limited by parallel suites). Report JSON: node e2e/docx/admin-report.mjs <report>; .docx: node e2e/docx/build-docx.mjs e2e/docx/reports/<report>.json

accounts.login: e2e-admin@nawy.test (E2eSeeder), own session per worker, password + emailed 2FA

issues.description: ADM-52 'void the gift card' passed only because the text 'Void' was on the page (the Void form itself); it opened the card and read its form before the card page had loaded, so the reason was skipped and nothing was voided.
issues.fix: ADM-52 waits for the card page, fills the reason, and checks 'Gift card voided.', status Cancelled, balance AED 0.00, the reason in the history and that the Void form is gone.

issues.description: Creating a platform campaign with the Influencer picker on 'None' failed with 'The influencer_ids.0 field must be an integer' (and the error was not shown, see BT-ADM-001), so platform campaigns open only to affiliates could not be created.
issues.fix: CampaignAdminController@store drops the empty option before validation. Regression: MarketerPanelsAndDocumentsTest 'creates a platform campaign when the influencer picker is left on "None" (BT-ADM-004)'.

issues.area: All panels (layout) / customers, classifieds, campaigns, blog, help
issues.description: A refused submit of a compact form (list-row status change with reason, classified reject, platform campaign create, blog post, help article) showed no message at all — the page just reloaded, so it looked like nothing happened. On Customers the status filter also picked up the row form's old 'status' input.
issues.fix: x-layouts.panel now shows an error summary (role=alert) for every field error; pages with their own summary opt out (:error-summary=false); x-ui.select gets :use-old=false for GET filters (customers). Regression: QaWave3JobsAndLifecyclesTest 'suspends and bans customer accounts…' (alert + message + filter value).

issues.description: Several messages use raw attribute keys: 'The name en field is required.' (categories), 'The values.street field is required.' (seller change requests), 'The category id field is required.' (warranty plans), 'The body ar field is required.' (blog/help, field not marked required).
issues.fix: Add attribute names (validation.attributes or per-request attributes()).

issues.description: Actors are shown as 'Admin #37' (statement 'Prepared by', voucher/flash-sale history 'By') instead of the staff member's name.
issues.fix: Resolve the user name in the views.

notes: Re-run of 2026-11-19: results, steps and screenshots are from the full Playwright run after the big catalogue (servers on a fresh production build). Issues BR-xx were found and fixed in this run; older issues are kept for reference.
Travel packages: nothing was waiting for review in dev, and packages of the E2E travel agency are reserved for the travel suite, so approve/reject was not exercised here.
Ads review queues (sponsored campaigns, slot bookings, bank-transfer packages) were empty in dev.
Celebrity monthly report 2026-10: no influencer earnings in dev, so no report row/PDF exists to open.
ADM-58 decides two older QA classified ads (CL-AE-0000005/7) once; E2E ads of the Open Souq suite were left in the queue.

Totals and steps are the latest recorded run of each flow (e2e/docx/reports/_log/*.jsonl, generated by e2e/docx/admin-report.mjs). Earlier runs that failed were test-script fixes or the bugs listed in 'Issues found', all fixed before the final run.

All data created by these flows carries a run suffix (e.g. 'QA Brand 9abc12x'). Records of today's e2e suites (E2E Store parcels, E2E travel agency, listing 19, E2E Open Souq ads) were not decided or changed.
Backend fixes take effect immediately (PHP/Blade); no website or panel asset rebuild is needed for any fix in this report.
